findings.title: Poll portfolio board visibility as well as project membership
findings.trigger: Member opens /projects; Owner revokes that member's only board grant while preserving project membership. Member receives fresh session/projects responses and another foreground polling cycle.
findings.proof: Independent real Chrome/API/PostgreSQL browser01 group2: canonical authenticated board list returned200 with[]; hub still displayed Browser regression board after foreground session/projects200 responses and19seconds. Screenshot projects-after-board-revoke.png; method/path/status ledger preserved.
findings.cause: usePortfolio's boards and board-stats queries are never registered for foreground polling. ProjectsScreen registers only accessible-projects. Session fingerprint has project membership/role/archive but no board-grant revision, so this revocation does not invalidate the cached list.
findings.effect: An open Projects hub continues showing a board name, link and prior card counts after its grant is removed; current effective access is misrepresented. Board metadata/count edits likewise remain stale on this screen.
findings.counterevidence: The canonical API correctly returned no boards. Existing board-screen image/card revocation passed in root run07. This is a distinct hub cache path, not a server authorization bypass.
findings.fix: Register displayed board-list and board-stat keys for polling, invalidate removed board snapshots/stats when a fresh list excludes them, and erase refused content. Verify grant removal at the hub plus metadata/count updates without navigation.
findings.confidence: high: actual UI and PostgreSQL reproduction

findings.title: Invalidate server-derived card baselines outside QueryClient on refusal
findings.trigger: Open a card without editing anything; an authorized read later returns401/403/404 and discardRefusedRows clears its protected QueryClient entry, or the session fingerprint clears QueryClient.
findings.proof: Executed probes/private-draft-retention.mjs: QueryClient data becameundefined after synthetic ApiError403; the separate actor/card store still returned the entire untouched server description in both base and draft, even after client.clear(). Six explicit checks passed. No module invalidation API or calling refusal hook exists in the inspected code.
findings.cause: Every opened card is copied wholesale into the permanent module map, including its clean server baseline, with no eviction/redaction path. CardDetailDrawer's refused-data effect touches only QueryClient; SessionProvider likewise clears only queries.
findings.effect: Protected fetched data remains in app memory after the app learns of access loss. It is not restricted to the user's unsent changes, contrary to the explicit card-safety acceptance criterion.
findings.counterevidence: Different actors receive separate stores, the visible drawer hides the refused card, and explicit logout hard-navigates, which unloads module state. No cross-account rendered disclosure or remote exploit is claimed. The observed defect concerns revocation/expiry within the same loaded tab and the stated private-cache retention requirement.
findings.fix: Separate user-entered changes/unresolved request identity from fetched clean baselines; invalidate/redact server-derived per-resource memory on refusal and access loss while retaining only scoped unsent user work. Apply the same policy to clean settings/brief baselines rather than clearing QueryClient alone.
findings.confidence: high for retention; no demonstrated cross-account UI disclosure

findings.title: Route Escape only to the topmost dialog
findings.trigger: On a board open Invite people, type an unsent email, then follow its People > Board access link. The unsaved-navigation confirmation opens over the invitation. Press Escape once.
findings.proof: Independent browser01 group3: navigation alertdialog disappeared and parent Invitation dialog count also became0; board URL remained; zero invitation POSTs. Screenshot nested-escape.png.
findings.cause: Each DialogLayer installs a capture listener on the same document. stopPropagation does not stop other listeners on that same target. All open layers therefore receive Escape; older parent listener runs as well.
findings.effect: Dismissing the navigation decision also dismisses the underlying work dialog, breaking nested keyboard behavior and predictable focus return. Parent dialog layers are also not made inert by the current app/drawer-only locks.
findings.counterevidence: The unsent invitation survives in its actor/project store and no invitation is sent. This is a confirmed accessibility/navigation defect, not demonstrated draft loss or unauthorized mutation.
findings.fix: Maintain a dialog stack; only its top layer handles Escape/Tab and lower layers are inert. Verify nested navigation and drawer/image dialogs, single Escape, Shift+Tab and focus restoration.

findings.title: Expose an explicit fresh full-card form after a confirmed creation
findings.trigger: Create one card through /add-card?board=...; choose Back to board; use native Back to return to /add-card, or revisit this route within the same client session.
findings.proof: Independent browser01 group1: actual card POST201 and exactly one PostgreSQL row; returning showed the old success receipt with zero visible title fields and zero visible New card controls. Screenshot add-card-return.png.
findings.cause: The actor/board form permanently retains createdId; submit returns early while it exists. The sole New card button is hidden and only calls router.refresh, which does not clear the module store. createCardForms offers no reset/new-attempt method.
findings.effect: The full-form path cannot create a second card for that board in the same loaded tab. Users must discover quick-add or reload the whole app.
findings.counterevidence: The first card is created exactly once and the retained receipt correctly prevents accidental duplicate submission. Quick-add remains available; preserving the receipt on Back itself is useful. The missing piece is an explicit new operation after confirmed success.
findings.fix: Add visible Create another card that allocates/reset a fresh form and command after a definite success, preserving the previous receipt and never resetting unresolved operations. Verify two intended creations produce two rows while retries of the first still create one.
findings.confidence: high: actual browser and PostgreSQL reproduction
